operands.about: operands of every kind (strings, resources, assignments, loops) under an operator, section children and operator grouping, at versions 0 to 13

syntax.about: tokens, literals, sections, statements and operators

depth.about: deeply nested inputs, a pair per shape around the depth limit (with the shape, repetitions, node depth and input length)

extra.about: assignments, `->` and `??` whose target or left side is not a plain variable

precedence_and_tokens.about: operator precedence and grouping, tokens, literal forms and empty input

coalescing.about: `??`: what its left side may be, and blocks on either side

assignment.about: what an assignment may target and what it may assign

operand_kinds.about: non-numeric operands of arithmetic, comparisons, logical operators and math functions

statements.about: statement lists, `break` / `continue`, `for_each`, conditional blocks and unreachable statements

evaluated_arithmetic.about: expressions that also have a reference value: literals and arithmetic, parsed

evaluated_math_calls.about: expressions that also have a reference value: math functions, parsed

evaluated_statements.about: expressions that also have a reference value: statements, conditionals, loops and variables, parsed
